ai.title: Give your AI the right tone.
ai.text: Configure the AI identity, personality, and opt-in experiments for this server.
ai.introText: All settings apply only to this server.
ai.coreDetail: Decide when the AI joins the conversation.
ai.nameHint: 3–32 characters; this is also the mention trigger
ai.enableHint: Respond when the configured name is mentioned
ai.experimentsDetail: Each experiment includes a learn-more explanation before you enable it.
ai.context.title: Better context
ai.context.hint: Use the last five channel messages
ai.context.info: Adds recent conversation and replied-to message context so responses understand ongoing discussions more naturally. It is useful for follow-ups, but sends more conversation context to the AI provider.
ai.actions.title: AI actions
ai.actions.hint: Allow confirmed actions requested in chat
ai.actions.info: Lets the AI propose polls and server actions such as moderation or channel management. Every action requires confirmation and is still limited by Discord permissions.
ai.multimodal.title: Multimodal conversation
ai.multimodal.hint: Understand images and voice in AI replies
ai.multimodal.info: Allows Niko to inspect image attachments and use voice-message transcriptions as context when the AI is already triggered by name, ping, or the ai command. Attachments never start a conversation on their own. Media is processed only while enabled and provider usage costs may apply.
